title: Feature Loop PRD Schema
description: Schema for Product Requirements Documents used in Huxley Feature Loop autonomous development

branch.description: Git branch name for this feature (defaults to 'feature/[sanitized-name]')

governance.description: Governance settings for quality and safety gates

requireValidation.description: Require Validator agent to verify each task before marking complete (default: true)

notifyOnComplete.description: Send macOS notification when loop completes or reaches max iterations (default: true)

costAlertThreshold.description: Iteration number at which to start warning about costs (default: 5)

tasks.description: List of tasks to complete for this feature

description.description: Detailed task description with context and requirements
examples: Create a FastAPI endpoint that generates JWT access tokens and refresh tokens using RS256 algorithm. Store refresh tokens in Redis with 7-day expiry.

specialist.description: Huxley agent to delegate this task to (will be resolved to full emoji name)

priority.description: Priority level (1 = highest, lower numbers execute first)

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of criteria that must be met for task to pass

examples: Returns valid JWT on successful authentication
Includes refresh token in response payload
Tokens expire correctly after configured duration

passes.description: Whether task has passed all acceptance criteria (set by loop)

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when task was completed (set by loop)

learnings.description: Key learnings captured during task implementation (appended by loop)

examples: Used PyJWT library with RS256 algorithm for better security
Stored refresh tokens in Redis with 7-day expiry
Added rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks
